body: Package dependency DAG (no cycles): @filemark/core has zero @filemark deps; tasks is pure TS (no React/deps); csv/chart/kanban depend on core(+datagrid); mdx composes core+datagrid+chart+kanban+tasks; schema-viewer depends on core + mdx-viewer (reuses Mermaid to render db-schema-toolkit output) — schema's mdx dep is the only non-core intra-@filemark dep besides mdx's composite. Playground share: ?src=<base64> normal, ?srcz=<gzip+base64> for large docs (DecompressionStream on mount, srcz stripped after decode).
